government: Union of self-governing esferas; the [[vysokij-stol]] (three allens per esfera) and an elected supremo
army: Fifteen combat-ready divisions, [[ortiyar]] fortress, rifled carbines and howitzers
ending: Mobilization is debated without a decision; reformists strike; the election of a supremo is still ahead
society: Esferas, [[braslet|bracelets]], [[obrero|obreros]], and [[duelnyj-spor|duel debates]]; no taxes or duties
notes: Spanish flavor, “but not Spain”; materialists, mirns rather than gods, and steam technology

government: The Kaiser, the patriarch and the magnus of the fishermen’s guild; the [[kogti-kajzera]]
army: Eagles as officers and stones as rank and file; flintlocks and mortars; supplied by rail
ending: Occupies central [[ollandiya]]; Hofmeyer is near Mershants; [[dunkvald]] is destroyed
society: Eagles, hares, and enslaved stones; faith in the [[seyatel]] and the feeding rite
notes: German flavor, “not Prussia”; airships, marks, and the Chinhar Wars

government: A grand principality of princes and voivodeships, effectively under Dangarian occupation
army: Hussars and the princes’ retinues with no unified command; two Catalian howitzers near Mershants
ending: The center is occupied by Dangar; the north resists; the south and Mershants await assault
society: Nobles, bourgeoisie, and peasants; no slavery; pride without industry
notes: Resembles the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth; Slavic names; all locomotives are Catalian

government: A state that acts through protests and prohibitions in the novel
ending: Blocks Dangarian steamships on the [[khursla]]; takes no part in the fighting
society: Scholars and a university; white chocolate and valissian
notes: Home of [[liess-van-khalm|van Halm]]; the western edge of the world for Laertans

capital: Unnamed; the supreme ruler is the sultan
government: Emirates united by one faith and a sultan; they unite when necessary
army: Galleys; sea power was lost on the Sea of Miriam
ending: Does not take part; Catalia’s trading partner and a possible refuge for emigrants
society: Monotheism; slavery is forbidden; harems and silk trading
notes: Religious enemies of Dangar; the sorcerer Faid Musa; former ally of [[solanta]]
